text:
nora: Hey @devex hitting a weird onboarding snag. Followed the sample-app quickstart (Docker) and the app logs show a 402 PaymentRequired on first SDK call. Console shows my workspace as active and billing attached.

onboarding-bot: Welcome! Workspace 'orchid-sandbox' created. Note: paid endpoints require workspace billing to be linked.

ash: Can you paste the exact log and what env vars you supplied to the container?

nora: Log: `2026-02-15T14:12:34Z ERROR redwood: PaymentRequired workspace_not_linked`. I used docker-compose with an env_file that sets REDWOOD_DEV_KEY=sk_test_xyz. I did not set REDWOOD_API_KEY.

sdk-bot: Info: SDKs expect REDWOOD_API_KEY. Legacy var REDWOOD_DEV_KEY is accepted only in Node (backcompat).

ash: Ah — looks like sample's README uses REDWOOD_DEV_KEY in examples (old). Node SDK tolerated it, but Go/Python/Java SDKs now prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY. That mismatch will cause the gateway to treat the token as non-workspace or unauthenticated leading to 402 in some flows.

nora: Welding two confusing things: (1) docker-entrypoint in sample uses `env -i` then sources a minimal env, which dropped my exported shell vars, and (2) README suggested REDWOOD_DEV_KEY. I think a user would believe the console billing message means they're ready.

ash: We need three fixes: update sample README to use REDWOOD_API_KEY, change entrypoint to preserve env or document env_file caveat, and make SDKs emit a clearer startup warning when only legacy vars are present.

docs: I'll update the quickstart: remove legacy var, add a troubleshooting section "402 on first call" with steps: check env var names, confirm workspace vs personal token, run `echo $REDWOOD_API_KEY` inside the container, and show curl vs SDK parity check.

nora: Workaround that got me past it: `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_xyz sample-app` — first call succeeded, app printed `Using API key from REDWOOD_API_KEY` and returned 200. :tada:

sdk-bot: Filed ticket RED-6120: "quickstart: standardize env var name -> REDWOOD_API_KEY; sample entrypoint to preserve env; SDKs log which var used; improve 402 message when auth/env mismatch."

ash: Also proposal: SDK should validate key presence at startup and fail fast with `Missing API key: set REDWOOD_API_KEY` rather than retrying and surfacing a 402. The retry loop is what misled me into thinking it was rate/quota.

docs: I'll add a one-liner to quickstart and a tiny snippet to detect missing vars at runtime.

nora: First successful call confirmed after the fix. Leaving this thread for the onboarding playbook.

ash: Thanks — devex ticket owners: assigning to eng-sdks and infra-samples.

sdk-bot: Created PR https://github.com/redwood/sample-app/pull/999 (entrypoint/env fixes) and issue tracker RED-6120.
